decisions.reason: Although close to the firm's core office offer, the desk system was visible only in 2018-2019 and its disappearance suggests performance below aspiration, so resources should be redirected to stronger core lines and new development.

The chair family fits the established portfolio, but its short observed market presence indicates it likely did not clear aspiration levels in a broad premium range where management can reallocate effort to better-performing seating products.

The floor cushions built on the existing offer but appear to have had only a brief run, so under a behavioral logic they should be discontinued once results remain uncertain and fall short of aspirations.

Even with stronger promotion in 2019, the sofa does not appear to have sustained a lasting market presence, implying that continued support is not justified relative to aspiration levels and alternative uses of resources.

The high standing table was near the firm's core business, yet the lack of continued visibility after 2019 points to insufficient performance, making withdrawal the prudent choice despite available organizational slack.

As the most distant product from the established offer, the rug collection would face the toughest aspiration test, and its brief observed presence suggests management would end it and refocus on core furniture and interior systems.
